# Nosy

Nosy about your product. Never your data.

Nosy is a product manager that lives inside your coding agent. It reads your backend, git history and roadmap; checks what rivals shipped; and tells you what you can build next: sized, placed on the roadmap, with a receipt for every claim.

## What it reads, writes and sends

- Reads: Nosy reads your code, git history, GitHub issues and PRs including their text (titles, bodies, comments and author logins, through your own `gh`), your decision and roadmap docs, and public web pages.
- Writes: Nosy writes to your `pm/` folder, plus a few named files: temporary files, a first-run marker, the skill folders `nosy install` copies and files you name with a flag. The optional weekly GitHub Action commits and pushes `pm/state/` and the decision page only if you set `commit: "true"`.
- Sends: Nothing of yours leaves on its own. Nosy's network calls are reads: the public rival pages you listed, and GitHub through your own `gh`, including a read-only lookup of the `#N` issues your agent's answer cites (`NOSY_CITE_GH=0` turns that off). `nosy notify` and `nosy publish` send something only when you run them, and `publish` is off until you configure a target and confirm (counts and structure, never quotes).
- No telemetry. The full list is in docs/DATA.md (see Links).

## Install

**Claude Code (default):**
```
/plugin marketplace add nosy-hq/nosy
/plugin install nosy@nosy
```

**Any coding agent in one command:**
```
npx github:nosy-hq/nosy install
```

Send the two Claude Code commands one at a time. Then, with the plugin, run `/nosy:move-in` (plugin commands are always `/nosy:<command>`, the top-level skill is `/nosy:nosy`). With the skill-only install, type `/nosy` (Codex: `$nosy`). Or ask your agent to run Nosy commands.

## Paste to your agent

"Read https://github.com/nosy-hq/nosy, then run `npx github:nosy-hq/nosy install` in my repo; it copies the skill folder into this project and changes no settings. Then type `/nosy`. If anything fails, do not retry: run `npx github:nosy-hq/nosy doctor --check` and show me its output."

`doctor --check` checks Node (18.17+), git, gh, the skill files and hooks, and prints the fix next to every failing line.

---

The plugin is free and MIT. Nosy Cloud (cloud.nosy.sh) is live and free for now: a shared record for your team. It never changes what the plugin does. Sample report: https://cloud.nosy.sh/demo
